You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: Move the red_book to the orange_tray, the yellow_mug to the cyan_tray, and any toy blocks to the purple_box. Before placing any object, check that its target zone is empty; if occupied, clear the zone first by moving the obstructing object to a temporary location (if necessary) and return it after. Ensure all objects are placed correctly and no object remains on the desk. Success is confirmed when all specified objects are in their correct zones and the desk is free of unassigned objects.
Goals: [{"object": "red_book", "zone": "orange_tray"}, {"object": "yellow_mug", "zone": "cyan_tray"}]

Current scene (from the camera):
{"table_z": 0.8, "objects": {"red_book": {"kind": "book", "center": [0.1045, -0.2108, 0.8125], "top_z": 0.8249, "height": 0.025, "footprint_long": 0.0733, "footprint_short": 0.0537, "long_axis_yaw": 0.463}, "yellow_mug": {"kind": "mug", "center": [0.1307, 0.061, 0.835], "top_z": 0.87, "height": 0.07, "footprint_long": 0.0533, "footprint_short": 0.0476, "long_axis_yaw": -1.506}}, "zones": {"orange_tray": {"name": "orange_tray", "center": [0.0, 0.1539, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0668, 0.0649]}, "cyan_tray": {"name": "cyan_tray", "center": [0.0482, -0.0612, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0668, 0.0649]}, "purple_box": {"name": "purple_box", "center": [-0.0556, -0.2188, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0556, 0.0519]}}, "gripper": {"width": 0.0795, "closed_command": false, "holding_something": false}, "end_effector": {"position": [-0.1977, 0.0004, 1.08], "yaw": 1.547}}

Order the goals into steps. A zone that is covered by an object must be cleared first (move that
object to its own destination). Skip objects that are already resting on their target zone.

{"steps": [{"object": "<object name>", "zone": "<zone name>"}, ...]}
